hooks.name: Regenerate demo Insurgency Report
hooks.description: Manual hook: rebuild a fresh local snapshot (JSON + binary) from the curated real incidents so the globe demo always has data to show.

action.prompt: Run `.venv/bin/python -m pipeline.cli --out ./frontend/public/snapshots/latest --offline --fresh --date 2026-11-14`. `--fresh` ignores the snapshot already in the folder (otherwise the CLI accumulates onto it) and the date stays pinned to 2026-11-14 so the output matches the committed fixtures. The extraction agent is mandatory, so this needs valid AWS credentials and Bedrock model access: exit code 2 means the agent preflight failed (report it and stop); exit code 3 means more than 20% of the articles were discarded, so the report was written without the new strikes (report it); exit code 4 means the existing snapshot.json is invalid and nothing was written. On success, confirm that snapshot.json and snapshot.bin were produced, report the machine-strike count and report date (strikes older than RECENCY_WINDOW_DAYS=7 relative to the report date are dropped), and verify the binary decodes by running `cd rebellion-core && cargo test decode`. The CLI also adds 2026-11-14 to frontend/public/snapshots/manifest.json although no such dated folder exists, so finally run `bash frontend/scripts/sync-snapshots.sh --manifest-only` (rebuilds the manifest from the dated archive folders and keeps their runs, no AWS needed) and `cd frontend && npm test` (archive integrity) and report both results.
